source_summary: Tall vertical Chinese landscape with layered rocky mountains, misty distant ridgelines, hidden pavilions, dense groves, stream/water areas, bridges, and a small mounted traveler. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: distant_mountain_silhouettes
motifs.description: Isolate the pale background mountain ridges across the upper center and right: soft outlined peaks rising behind the middle landscape, with empty misty space between forms.
must_preserve: thin gray contour lines defining the ridgelines
very light tan-gray wash inside the mountain masses
soft mist gaps between overlapping peaks
subtle uneven brush pressure along the ridge edges

motifs.name: upper_left_terraced_hillside
motifs.description: Isolate the stepped rocky hillside at upper left, including layered horizontal ledges, scrub vegetation, and the prominent pine-like tree descending along the slope.
must_preserve: blocky terrace geometry with dark ink outlines
dry-brush rock texture and shaded cliff faces
small clustered shrubs along ledge tops
fine pine needles and twiggy vegetation
pale wash transitions on the sloping rock planes

motifs.name: upper_right_hidden_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion group tucked into the upper-right valley, including the main roofed pavilion, lower red-accented roofs, surrounding bamboo-like thickets, shrubs, and nearby pine.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry with angled eaves
red-brown roof and railing accents
vertical bamboo and shrub strokes around the buildings
fine pine branches above the pavilion
rocky enclosure framing the structures without adding distant seals or text

motifs.name: central_diagonal_rock_gorge
motifs.description: Isolate the central diagonal gorge of large pale rock slabs, dark crevices, clumps of vegetation, and two tall conifers rising from the rocky middle ground.
must_preserve: long sweeping diagonal rock contours
dark ink crevice lines and stippled rock bases
soft gray-brown wash on broad stone faces
needle-like conifer branches and leaning trunks
dense shrub dots along ravine edges
mist-softened separations between overlapping rock masses

motifs.name: right_mid_cliff_ravine
motifs.description: Isolate the angular rocky ravine on the middle right, with stacked cliff faces, a narrow descending gully, dotted vegetation, and dry-brush texture.
must_preserve: faceted cliff outlines with sharp turns
layered rock blocks and interior crack lines
dark stippling at the base of slopes
thin vegetation strokes clinging to ledges
pale wash modeling on the vertical stone faces

motifs.name: lower_mid_grove_hut
motifs.description: Isolate the dense grove across the lower middle, including interlaced tree trunks and branches, the small hut or gate-like structure on the right, and the wooded bank behind it.
must_preserve: many pale trunks with dark shaded bark edges
fine twig networks and leaf-dot texture
layered depth between front and back trees
small hut roof and vertical wall or gate lines
subtle warm roof accents
low bank contours and scattered rocks beneath the trees

motifs.name: lower_stream_and_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the quiet lower stream or water surface with shoreline rocks, stepping stones, low banks, and faint bridge or plank lines near the left-middle foreground.
must_preserve: flat open water wash with minimal linework
thin horizontal bank and bridge/plank lines
small scattered rocks with ink outlines
dry-brush shading on larger shoreline stones
soft transitions where land meets water

motifs.name: mounted_traveler_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the small mounted traveler crossing the narrow bridge or path at lower left, including the mule or donkey, the red-robed rider, and the immediate bridge line beneath.
must_preserve: tiny animal silhouette with delicate legs and head
rider posture and hat/head detail
distinct red robe color accent
thin reins or guiding linework
straight bridge or path line beneath the figure
surrounding minimal ground strokes needed to anchor the crossing

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
